about: The chosen price basis per constituent after a corporate action that re-bases a column's history: a spin-off, a split a vendor applies retroactively, a currency-unit change.

Read by scripts/basis_guard.py from compute_breadth.download_prices immediately before each constituent cache is written. A column whose history arrives re-scaled by one split-sized ratio against the incumbent cache is admitted whole only when a declaration here (or, for an ordinary split, the vendor's own split calendar) says that series is the chosen basis; otherwise the cached history is kept and new sessions are appended only across an exact seam.

Fields: ticker (the roster ticker); effective (ISO calendar date of the first session traded on the new basis); factor (the vendor's adjustment factor: under 'adjusted' every pre-event close is divided by it, so a 2-for-1 split is 2.0 and a 1-for-10 reverse split 0.1); basis ('adjusted' admits the continuous adjusted series and refuses the raw one with a cliff at the event, 'unadjusted' the reverse); decided_on, decided_by, note (provenance).

A declaration matches when the event sits between the last re-based session and the first unchanged one and the factor matches the observed ratio within 10% in log terms. Nothing here forward-fills or fabricates a bar; a declaration only decides which of two served series the cache carries.

declarations.event: spin-off: Corteva separated 2026-10-01; the symbol now carries Vylor, Inc.
declarations.note: Norgate (TOTALRETURN) serves the spin-adjusted continuous series, every pre-event close divided by 6.6652; yfinance serves the raw series with a 6.6x cliff on 2026-10-01 and no split event. The owner rejected the cliff on 2026-10-03 and asked for the established adjusted basis to be kept. Factor measured at 6.665236 over 1,848 shared sessions in the CSP1 and IUMS caches.
